content.text: {"abstained":false,"abstention_reason":"","answer":"The NPS Vatsalya Scheme is a contributory saving cum long-term financial security scheme designed exclusively for minors [E03]. It is open to all citizens of India under 18 years of age, including Non-Resident Indians (NRIs) and Overseas Citizens of India (OCIs) [E03]. The scheme aims to enhance financial literacy and financial planning and encourage empowerment of children [E03]. Key features include power of compounding with financial security, financial discipline through regular investments, tax-efficient benefits, market-linked returns, and 24/7 online access [E03]. The account is opened by a parent/guardian in the minor's name, with the minor as the sole beneficiary and a unique Permanent Retirement Account Number (PRAN) issued [E03]. The minimum contribution is ₹250 per annum with no upper limit [E01]. Contributions can be made through physical mode at registered service providers or online modes including eNPS platform, UPI apps, and other PFRDA-approved electronic modes [E01][E02]. Partial withdrawals up to 25% of contributions are allowed after 3 years for education, medical treatment, or specified reasons [E02].
